crossRefs.note: Is this the way you repay Yahweh, foolish and unwise people? Isn’t he your father who has bought you? He has made you…
When David had come to the top, where God was worshiped, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his tunic…
When he had come to Jerusalem to meet the king, the king said to him, “Why didn’t you go with me, Mephibosheth?”
A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.
A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.

people.name: Absalom
people.line: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.

people.name: Hushai
people.line: David's friend and advisor who helped him during Absalom's rebellion.

translations.web: Absalom said to Hushai, “Is this your kindness to your friend? Why didn’t you go with your friend?”
translations.bsb: “Is this the loyalty you show your friend?” Absalom replied. “Why did you not go with your friend?”
translations.kjv: And Absalom said to Hushai, Is this thy kindness to thy friend? why wentest thou not with thy friend?
translations.asv: And Absalom said to Hushai, Is this thy kindness to thy friend? why wentest thou not with thy friend?
